description: Matched staged versus unstaged P2P served-model A/B. Experimental, not production qualification.
method: Same model and settings, control then staged candidate. One 64-token cold warmup, then three 524-token cold requests, three 4274-token cold requests and three deterministic decode requests per arm. The server start-to-first-token timing includes first-token generation; the client timing includes complete reply. Request IDs join client responses to server logs; nonzero or unknown cache reuse is rejected.

memory_admission.note: 8192 MiB minimum per card and at least prior service usage plus 256 MiB; a guard, not a measured rig footprint

limits: Only three measured requests per workload and one control-then-candidate order; thermal and order effects were not crossed over.
The stage and chunk paths were verified by startup admission logs and source control flow; the served-model dispatch was not profiled.
The context was configured to 262144 tokens, but the longest measured prompt was 4274 tokens.
No 128k/256k recall, multi-turn coding quality, or production qualification is established.
Guard observations are periodic and do not prove continuous exclusivity.
